content.rationale: The shape check is where routing meets vocabulary; the gate forces it to answer to the vocabulary rule without defining dispatchability itself. Its two edges span two cells — one prose parent (natural→natural) and one requirement-sentence parent (structured→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
